slides.headlineRest: formed by NVIDIA and 36 partners to secure AI
slides.body: NVIDIA, alongside 36 other major organizations, has established the Open Secure AI Alliance. This new coalition aims to foster the development and sharing of open technologies, techniques, and tools for robustly securing software and artificial intelligence agents. Members include industry giants from cloud, security, enterprise software, and AI sectors like Microsoft, Cisco, and IBM. The initiative addresses the growing need for collaborative efforts to build secure and trustworthy AI ecosystems.
